qa_pairs.question: What three preliminary steps must be completed before beginning the front axle final drive removal?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove front propeller shaft (see Gr. 26), remove left front wheel (see Gr. 36), and unscrew splash guard (see Gr. 51).

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is required to unscrew the left nut and press off the tie rod?
What special tool is needed to pull off the left output shaft?
Where is the ring of Special Tool 31 5 011 located during use?
qa_pairs.answer: The ring of Special Tool 31 5 011 is located in groove of shaft.

qa_pairs.question: What installation procedure should be followed when installing the output shaft back into the front axle final drive?
qa_pairs.answer: Pressure spindle rests on bolt head, screw in pressure spindles alternately, push spring pivot toward outside until output shaft slides out of front axle final drive.

qa_pairs.question: What special tool is used to unscrew the left nut and press off the control arm?
What installation requirements are specified for the control arm connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Keep grease out of bore and off of pin, follow tightening torque specifications, and lock nut with cotter pin.

qa_pairs.question: Which special tools are required to pull the right output shaft out of the front axle final drive?
What should be done with the seal when removing the front axle final drive?
What cross-reference is provided for installation procedures?
What important installation note is given for both tie rod and control arm procedures?
qa_pairs.answer: Keep grease out of bore and off of pin, and follow tightening torque specifications.
